programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him.

programme.title: The Invisible Man Returns
programme.desc: Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

programme.title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
programme.desc: A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Invisible Ray
programme.desc: A scientist (Bela Lugosi) seeks an antidote for a radium-poisoned colleague (Boris Karloff) with the touch of death.

programme.title: The Invisible Woman
programme.desc: A screwy professor's experiments with a gorgeous model attract the attentions of a gangster and a handsome millionaire.

programme.title: Island of Lost Souls
programme.desc: In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space
programme.desc: While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

programme.title: Kiss of the Vampire
programme.desc: A professor (Clifford Evans) in black rescues stranded 1910 newlyweds from a Bavarian doctor's (Noel Willman) vampire villa.

programme.title: The Mad Doctor of Market Street
programme.desc: A fugitive doctor (Lionel Atwill) tries to raise the dead for South Sea Islanders.

programme.title: The Mad Ghoul
programme.desc: A mad scientist (George Zucco) turns his assistant (David Bruce) into a zombie as part of a plan to steal his assistant's lover (Evelyn Ankers).

programme.title: Man-Made Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.

programme.title: The Monster and the Girl
programme.desc: A mad scientist creates a monster when he transplants the brain of an executed murderer into the body of an ape.

programme.title: Monster on the Campus
programme.desc: A professor turns into a Neanderthal killer after injecting himself with the blood of an ancient fish.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

programme.title: The Mummy's Curse
programme.desc: A mummy (Lon Chaney Jr.) and his princess (Virginia Christine) roam the Louisiana bayou.

programme.title: The Mummy's Ghost
programme.desc: A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Garra de Tigre
programme.desc: Un maestro de artes marciales cría a tres niños para que sean hombres de bien y sepan defenderse de "Garra de Tigre".

programme.title: El Mofles y los Mecánicos
programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado
programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1
programme.desc: A fantastical encounter lies at the heart of this documentary: a meeting between the bronze figures of Sanxingdui and the mask of the great Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun. ‘Treasures and Masks’ represents a cutting-edge bridging of ancient Chinese and Egyptian civilizations that has to be seen to be believed.

J.R. talks about his growth and mental health struggles during his NBA career and his decision to attend an HBCU after retirement, Chloe speaks on her upcoming projects and the first time she felt separated from her sister, Halle, Chiney explains how she earned her respect on and off the court as a broadcaster, and Kenya shares why he gets backlash for telling Black stories. programme.title: The Shop

Teyana shares how she balanced pain and motherhood while filming A Thousand And One and how returning to Harlem allowed her to be vulnerable, Babyface breaks down the process of using emotion to create music for artists over different generations, Allyson explains her fight for maternal protection guarantees in women's track and field contracts, Tabitha takes us through the practice of healing and grace and how she always stays true to herself, and Bobby shares his vision behind the creation of The Hundreds and the community it represents. programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design and fashion moments from Mike Nichols' 1988 film "Working Girl," starring Melanie Griffith, Sigourney Weaver, and Harrison Ford. The hosts explore how Ann Roth's costume choices—from Tess's working-class Staten Island attire to her polished corporate wardrobe—reflect her transformation from secretary to executive. They discuss iconic 80s trends including big hair, commuter shoes, bold eyeshadow, shoulder pads, and the evolution of her style throughout the film, analyzing how fashion serves as a character development tool.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London return to discuss costume design in the three-hour action film "One Battle After Another," exploring eight key looks worn by characters including revolutionary Perfidia Beverly Hills (Teyana Taylor), Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio), and other ensemble cast members. The hosts praise costume designer Colleen Atwood's deliberate approach to wardrobe, analyzing how choices like safety orange camouflage, a pregnant character in military gear, and carefully detailed thrift-store aesthetics serve the story without becoming distracting. The conversation examines how costume design can be both detailed and subtly supportive of character development, comparing this film's approach to other cinema styles and discussing how clothing choices communicate character archetypes and backgrounds.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The Improbable Grill: In this show we explore three unexpected techniques for grilling. The first stands the vertical rotisserie used in Mexico and the Middle East. The second involves a piece of equipment you don’t usually find at a barbecue—a roofer’s torch. The third involves a mystery ingredient that virtually no one on the planet has ever grilled.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Cured and Smoked: In humankind’s long march to food security, two ancient preserving techniques have stood out over the millennia: curing and smoking. The first involves preserving foods with salt, soy sauce, or sodium nitrite, and the second technique involves blasting foods with flavorful clouds of wood smoke. Today, we’re pushing the envelope on traditional curing and smoking.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Raichlen’s Rules: Desserts: Take your desserts to a new level of flavor with Grilled Pound Cake with Berry Salsa and Smoked Whipped Cream, Salt Slab-Grilled Pears with Amaretti And Smoked Whipped Cream, Dessert Quesadillas, Smoked Ice Cream with Rum Raisin Sauce.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Let Texans brag about brisket and Carolinians praise pulled pork shoulder. For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue is ribs. In the American Midwest, ribs mean baby backs or other pork ribs, while in Korea, the bone of choice is the beef short rib. In the eastern Mediterranean, lamb ribs reign supreme. In this show we give you three of the best ribs ever.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Health Food: A little-known fact-Steven Raichlen’s first James Beard Award-winning book wasn’t about barbecue, but a book on healthy eating. This show harnesses the flavor- boosting, fat-melting power of live fire to produce grilled fare that not only tastes good but is good for you. From the paellas of Spain to the grilled beef salads of Southeast Asia.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire. In this show we embark on some meaty globe hopping, exploring over-the-top steaks from France, Cambodia, and the American Southwest. Hot fire. Sizzling meat. It’s a carnivore’s dream come true.

programme.desc: Explore the CAG bird inside Wings Over the Rockies Air Space Museum and take a trip to Naval Air Station Whidbey Island to visit the home of electronic attack for the entire DoD. Youll find yourself on the runway with EA-18s screaming by, face to face with active pilots leading the Navys mission and take a tour of a Navy base built to protect the USAs Western coast during WWII.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Join Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette as he goes flying with a Metropolitan State University of Denver student over some of Denvers most popular landmarks, learns about the desperate need for airline pilots and gets a soup to nuts look at the 172 Skyhawk in Independence, Kansas.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: The UH-1 Iroquois (Huey) is THE iconic aircraft of the Vietnam War. In the season 2 premiere of Behind the Wings, take a trip to Wings Over the Rockies Air Space Museum in Denver, CO with host Matthew Burchette as he highlights a combat-veteran Huey, interviews two Vietnam War Huey pilots and even tags along on a training mission with the US Coast Guard to showcase the U.S. militarys latest helo.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: In this special episode of Behind the Wings, tag along as host Matthew Burchette explores one of the militarys best-kept secrets - North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD). Get a private tour of the N2C2 command center, experience a Noble Eagle Conference in action and fly along as Matthews venture into restricted airspace puts him up close and personal with Buckley AFBs 140th Wing. This is access that few ever receive.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: 2019 marked the 50th anniversary of the Apollo 11 lunar landing. This incredible milestone changed the way humanity looked at our planet and access to deep space. Join Behind the Wings host Matthew Burchette as he sits down with NASAs Gene Kranz, summarizes the amazing events leading up to Apollo 11 and uncovers the fascinating future NASA has in store for space exploration.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: The Beechcraft Company has been in existence for more than 88 years and has built some of the most influential aircraft in history. Join host Matthew Burchette as he dives into the history of the iconic Beechcraft 18, explores its history as the C-45 Expeditor and ventures to Centennial Airport in Englewood, Colorado to link up with the Colorado State Patrols (CSP) Aviation Section. If you are lucky, you may even get a ride in CSPs souped-up Beechcraft King Air.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Wildfires are growing in intensity, and firefighting aviation is becoming increasingly crucial to saving forests and lives in Colorado and beyond. Fire aviation teams are critical, complex efforts, made up of pilots, technicians, and coordinators who work together with ground crews to put out and contain wildfires. As environmental conditions set the stage for unprecedented fire seasons, night vision goggle technology is employed for the first time, and Colorado legislatures are paying closer attention than ever to the importance of wildfires. The progress is clear, yet so much remains to be done.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: New fire conditions call for new firefighting methods and tools. Looking at Calfire, we learn how the largest municipal fleet of firefighting aircraft in the world has developed over time. Live data feeds revolutionize how firefighting teams understand fires and communicate during missions. Colorado gets ready to purchase its first Firehawk helicopter, and interagency teams coordinate at the local, state, and federal levels. The challenges in fighting wildfires are greater than ever, but with new methods of fighting the fires, so are the opportunities.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: In the 1950s, The Century Series defined an era of aviation during the Cold War, charting a metamorphosis from one era to another. Jets were in their infancy, and many milestones, including the sound barrier, loomed large. In an arms race with the Soviet Union, a rising superpower, the U.S. got to work developing a variety of impressive fighter jets, now known as the Century Series. Starting with the F-100, the first production airplane to break the sound barrier in level flight, we explore how the century series pioneered new airplane designs, including the aerodynamic coke bottle shape made famous by the F-102. The F-104, a missile with a man in it inspired a generation of pilots. The F-105 looked like a fighter but was a bomber in disguise. As a series, their legacy is evident in modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: For nearly sixty years the Learjet came to define a new class of luxury airplane the business jet. Now, the last Learjet ever is being assembled at the Wichita-based production facility in The Aviation Capital of the World. Speaking with aviation icons past and present, we get an intimate look at a company that shaped aviation as we know it today. From its record-setting performance achievements to its outsized role in popular culture, the Learjets place in history is here to stay, long after the production lines shut down.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Early Space Exploration was defined by a Space race between the United States and the Soviet Union in a quest for national bragging rights. Major milestones like the first artificial Earth satellite, landing on the moon, and eventually creating the International Space Station (ISS) in 1993. Astronauts experience a psychological sensation called The Overview Effect. The ISS marked a new focus on international collaboration in Space. On the ISS, scientists are conducting novel research that is revolutionizing our understanding of life on earth -- from monitoring air pollution to fermenting beer. With the ISS expected to shut down in the coming decades, private space stations may play a larger role in the future of space- and exploration.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: From cave drawings to the identification of star constellations in the night sky, the cosmos has fascinated humankind. Space exploration also provides a unique vantage to look back at Earth. Satellite sensing enables new discoveries about climate change, natural disasters, and civilization. Researchers high in the Rocky Mountains are using satellites, and more than 50 different sensor types to create prediction models of complex watersheds. Mapping technology has become an irreplaceable part of our daily lives and helps plan everything from vaccine distribution, to chimpanzee populations. With the exponential increase in satellites in recent years, comes a need for more space infrastructure, and new challenges like space debris. The opportunities in space exploration are greater than ever but for a burgeoning space economy, so are the challenges.

programme.title: Behind the Wings
programme.desc: Technological advances and private investments have enabled a new era in space exploration. Billionaires and private equity are leading the charge, at times in partnership with public space agencies. The impacts are profound in the variety and frequency of space activity. One where anyone can be a citizen astronaut, and for companies a customer. Space for Humanity is working towards a vision where anyone can be an astronaut, and Astro Access took that even further when they crewed a training mission entirely with people with disabilities. Space exploration is more ambitious today than ever before, yet the impact of commercialization with private astronauts, and private space stations - remains to be seen.

programme.desc: Ein abwechslungsreicher Abend mit besonderen Gästen steht bevor. Ex-Teilnehmer Walter und Casey Kelly sind zu Gast. Gemeinsam mit Sänger Bosson sorgen sie für musikalische Highlights, bevor mit dem aktuellen Exit auf die Zeit im Haus zurückgeblickt wird.

programme.title: Das Haus sortiert sich neu
programme.desc: Nach der Entscheidung beginnt für die verbliebenen Bewohner ein neuer Abschnitt. Die Gruppe muss sich neu finden und auch Freundschaften und Rollen im Haus verändern sich.

programme.title: Immer weniger Bewohner
programme.desc: Mit weniger Bewohnern verändert sich das Leben im Container. Man geht sich schwerer aus dem Weg und Gespräche über das Experiment, Freundschaften und die Zukunft werden persönlicher.

programme.title: Wer schafft es bis zum Ende?
programme.desc: Das Finale ist zwar noch entfernt, doch das Durchhalten wird zunehmend zum Thema. Die Bewohner sprechen über ihre Zeit im Haus und darüber, wie lange sie das Experiment noch durchziehen können.

programme.title: Köpfchen gefragt
programme.desc: Da kommen die Bewohner ganz schön ins Schwitzen! In dieser Spezialsendung müssen sie im Fragenhagel ihr Allgemeinwissen unter Beweis stellen. Nicht jeder hat auf jede Frage die richtige Antwort parat. Manche schlagen sich besser als andere.

programme.title: 60 Tage Big Brother!
programme.desc: 60 Tage im Container sind geschafft. Aus Fremden sind Freunde, Rivalen und Vertraute geworden. Doch der Alltag geht weiter und schon bald wartet die nächste Entscheidung auf die Bewohner.

programme.title: Der Endspurt rückt näher
programme.desc: Mehr als 60 Tage sind geschafft. Die Bewohner kennen ihre Stärken und Schwächen inzwischen genau. Freundschaften, Alltag und die nächste Entscheidung sorgen weiter für Gesprächsstoff.

programme.title: Neckereien unter Freunden und Rivalen
programme.desc: Das Zusammenleben wird immer intensiver. Zwischen den Bewohnern sorgen kleine Streiche für Überraschungen und weitere Neckereien.

programme.title: Wer scheidet heute aus?
programme.desc: Auch dieses Mal begrüßt "Big Brother – Die Entscheidung" besondere Gäste: Ex-Bewohner Michael, Modern Talking, Melanie Thornton und Harry Schmidt. Zudem wird gemeinsam mit dem aktuellen Exit die Erlebnisse im Big-Brother-Haus besprochen.

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Heute wird Shanias Geburtstag gefeiert! Nachdem die Schwestern Last Minute die Location und das Essen organisiert haben, kann jetzt die Party starten! Die Stimmung ist der Burner. Aber was geht zwischen Shania und Sonnyboy Josh?

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Die Geiss Schwestern machen zusammen mit Kumpel Ozan das Fürstentum Seborga unsicher. Selbst die Krone darf Davina Geiss mal aufsetzen! Ozan träumt derweilen von seiner Zukunft als Fürst...

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Die Girls spannen mit Opa Reinhold Geiss Pfeil und Bogen! Dabei lässt Davina Geiss Opa gewinnen und sichert sich damit den Titel als Lieblingsenkelkind. Shania Geiss lässt hier niemanden gewinnen, selbst wenn sie dafür schummeln muss...

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Alle anschnallen! Es geht von München nach Monaco! Während Shania Geiss ihr erstes eigenes Auto fährt, muss Davina Geiss ihr den Weg weisen. Doch es wird schnell hitzig und das absolute Chaos bricht aus!

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Davina und Shania Geiss sind mit ihren Freunden Skifahren! Eine Schlagzeile über die Girls sorgt bei Kumpel Ozan für Hitzewallungen. Davina hat allerdings andere Sorgen: Ihr Auge wurde bei einer Schneeballschlacht hart getroffen...

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Für Davina und Shania Geiss geht es auf das Oktoberfest in Monaco. Ein Job für Familienfriseur Ozan. Beim Frisieren nutzt er die Chance, um Davina über ihren "Typ Mann" auszuquetschen. Von wem sind eigentlich die Rosen, die am Eingang stehen?

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Davina Geiss erlebt Adrenalin pur beim Formel-E-Rennen und darf im Rennwagen Vollgas geben. Vorher muss sie jedoch ein heikles Dokument unterschreiben. Shania testet die Strecke mit Dominik Wehrlein, während Carmen in Maximilian Günther bereits einen möglichen Schwiegersohn sieht.

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Feueralarm im Hotel in Berlin! Nur wenige Türen von Davina und Shania Geiss' Zimmer entfernt, wird ein Feuer gelegt! Während die beiden Schwestern mit Mama Carmen Geiss draußen um Fassung ringen, fehlt von Robert Geiss jede Spur.

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss' runder Geburtstag muss geplant werden. Während Carmen gar nicht feiern möchte, haben die anderen beschlossen, dass sie da nicht drumherum kommt. Selbstverständlich braucht die Party auch ein heißes Motto: "Sixty Shades of Carmen".

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss eröffnet zu ihrem runden Geburtstag einen Tempel der Lust. Ein Event in Lack, Leder und mit Handschellen?! Da müssen sich selbst die prominenten Gäste wie Claudia Obert, Katja Krasavice und Capital Bra in Acht nehmen.

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Davina Geiss kommt endlich aus der OP. Doch die Nachwehen sind stärker als gedacht. Sie hat unglaubliche Schmerzen. Shania Geiss wagt gleich zwei Eingriffe beim Zahnarzt.

programme.title: Davina & Shania
programme.desc: Für Davina und Shania Geiss geht es zur "Vogue World" nach Paris. Dort erleben die beiden einen absoluten Fangirl-Moment: Von Katy Perry über Eva Longoria und Kendall Jenner bis hin zum einzig wahren Bad Bunny – alle Promi-Hochkaräter sind am Start!

programme.title: Mega Hausbesichtigung auf Ibiza!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss tauchen in die Welt der Luxusimmobilien ein. Eine der sündhaft teuren Immobilien ist eine riesige Villa auf Ibiza. (S1 E01)

programme.title: Kindergeburtstag-Desaster bei den Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss scheuen keine Kosten und Mühen, um einen riesigen Kindergeburtstag für Shania zu veranstalten. Doch einige Dinge scheinen den beiden einen Strich durch die Rechnung zu machen. Wird der Geburtstag trotzdem stattfinden? (S1 E02)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss' rockt mit Jürgen Drews die Bühne
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss verbringen ihren Urlaub auf Mallorca und treffen dabei keinen Geringeren als ihren Freund Jürgen Drews, den "König von Mallorca". Überwindet Carmen ihr Lampenfieber und traut sich mit auf die Bühne? (S1 E03)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss im Shopping-Wahn
programme.desc: In Saint Tropez ist Sommerschlussverkauf und Carmen Geiss ist im Shopping-Wahn - als Frau kann man schließlich nie genug Kleidung haben. Robert ist hingegen nicht so begeistert vom Shopping-Fieber seiner Frau... (S1 E04)

programme.title: Back to the Roots
programme.desc: Bei Carmen und Robert Geiss steht eine Reise in die Vergangenheit an: es geht zurück in ihre Heimatstadt Köln. Robert ist allerdings kein Fan von Deutschland - für Carmen wird es hingegen emotional. (S1 E05)

programme.title: Wahrsagerin zu Besuch!
programme.desc: Davina und Shania Geiss überraschen ihre Eltern mit dem Besuch einer bekannten Wahrsagerin. Was wird die Zukunft der Geissens bringen? (S1 E06)

programme.title: Überraschungs-Fail!​ Carmen Geiss ist enttäuscht
programme.desc: Robert Geiss möchte seine Frau Carmen in Cannes überraschen. Allerdings hat Carmen sich die Überraschung etwas anders vorgestellt… (S1 E07)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine Weltreise mit der ganzen Familie. Erster Halt: Athen. Da darf ein Besuch der Akropolis natürlich nicht fehlen. Carmen hat dabei ihre ganz eigene Zeitrechnung… (S2 E01)

programme.title: ​Mega Gönnung in Dubai & Skifahren bei 40 Grad
programme.desc: Für die Geissens darf ein Halt in der Luxusstadt Dubai auf ihrer Weltreise natürlich nicht fehlen. Ski fahren bei 40 Grad, ein Wettrennen durch die Wüste und Kamelreiten an einem Tag? Kein Problem für Familie Geiss. (S2 E02)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss besuchen ein Pferderennen in Hongkong – natürlich inklusive Wetten. Ob Carmens Einsatz auf mehrere Pferde klug ist? Seit über 10 Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI das glamouröse Leben der Kult-Millionäre zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events weltweit. (S2 E04)

programme.title: XXL-Shopping​​ & Super-Nanny
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss sind auf Shoppingtour, denn für ihre Luxusimmobilien benötigen sie eine luxuriöse Einrichtung. Dabei wird natürlich nicht gespart! Währenddessen passt Nanny Nummer 30 auf Shania und Davina auf. Ob sie die beiden im Griff hat? (S2 E05)

programme.title: Carmens Nerven liegen blank!
programme.desc: Für geschäftliche Termine reist die ganze Familie Geiss nach Kroatien. Dort angekommen werden Carmens Nerven nicht nur einmal auf die Probe gestellt... (S2 E07)

programme.title: Shopping-Drama in Dubrovnik
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss sind geschäftlich in Kroatien unterwegs. Carmen kann Dubrovnik natürlich nicht verlassen, ohne vorher shoppen gewesen zu sein. Allerdings gestaltet sich das Ganze schwieriger als gedacht... (S2 E08)

programme.title: Formel-1-Rennen​ & das erste Mal Bus fahren
programme.desc: Die Geissens sind total im Freizeitstress! Wie jedes Jahr möchte Robert das Formel-1-Rennen in Monaco besuchen - das ist allerdings nicht der einzige Termin, der auf das Wochenende fällt. Bei so viel Stress muss er sogar das erste Mal Bus fahren. (S2 E09)

programme.title: Geburtstags-Stress & Große Überraschung
programme.desc: Die Geissens schmeißen eine Geburtstagsparty für Tochter Davina - dafür muss noch einiges vorbereitet werden und Carmen gerät in Stress. Um die Vorbereitungen zu erleichtern, hat sie einen Überraschungsgast organisiert. (S2 E10)

programme.title: Schock bei den Geissens:​ Wird die Villa Geissini
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss freut sich auf eine entspannte und ruhige Familienzeit in der Villa Geissini in Saint-Tropez. Allerdings erhält Robert einen Anruf, der die ganze Planung durcheinanderbringt - ein Investor möchte die Villa kaufen... (S2 E11)

programme.title: Folge6
programme.desc: Zu den Gästen auf Grahams Sofa gehören heute Abend: der Komiker STEPHEN MANGAN, der in seinem neuen Film "Postman Pat" die Hauptrolle spielt, der kultige Modedesigner JEAN PAUL GAULTIER und die Musiklegende BARRY MANILOW.

programme.title: Folge17
programme.desc: Graham trifft Dominic Cooper, Miriam Margolyes und Lily Allen.

programme.title: Folge13
programme.desc: Mit James McAvoy, Sarah Paulson, Richard E. Grant, Steve Coogan und John C. Reilly.

programme.title: Folge9
programme.desc: Graham spricht mit Nicole Kidman, Julie Walters, Hugh Bonneville und Take That.

programme.title: Folge3
programme.desc: Graham spricht mit Robert De Niro, Michelle Pfeiffer, Jennifer Saunders und Cher.

programme.title: Folge11
programme.desc: Mit Madonna, Sir Ian McKellen, Danny Boyle, Lily James, Himesh Patel und Sheryl Crow,

programme.title: Folge9
programme.desc: Mit Ethan Hawke, Toni Collette, Aidan Turner, Jo Brand und Liam Payne.

programme.title: Folge8
programme.desc: Mit Melissa McCarthy, Jude Law, Chris Pratt, John Bishop und Florence and the Machine

programme.title: Folge10
programme.desc: Graham trifft Michael Keaton, Jamie Oliver, Victoria Wood, Ian McKellen und One Direction.

programme.title: Folge7
programme.desc: Gemeinsam auf Grahams Sofa heute Abend: Comedy-Liebling DAWN FRENCH, die über ihre Solo-Tourneen spricht Hollywood-Star KIRSTEN DUNST, die in ihrem neuen Film "Die zwei Gesichter des Januars" die Hauptrolle spielt Action-Mann und Survival-Experte BEAR GRYLLS und SAM SMITH,".

programme.title: Flight Attendant Has to Deliver Baby on Plane
programme.desc: After passengers Blair, Ryan, and Ava swap seats to escape their problems, they realize the grass isn't greener. They eventually reunite with their families, and Jess must deliver Camila's baby mid-flight.

programme.title: Kid Gets Trapped in Minecraft
programme.desc: Bossy student Jay refuses to listen to his art project partners. After a vivid Minecraft nightmare teaches him that great leaders must also be good followers, he learns to collaborate and wins.

programme.title: Influencer Mistreats Her Puppy
programme.desc: Influencer Megan adopts a puppy for clout but nearly surrenders him when he becomes a "burden." Realizing he'd be euthanized, she rescues him and uses her platform to get every dog in the shelter adopted.

programme.title: Cheerleader Mocks Guy for Weight
programme.desc: After being mocked for his weight, Miles uses his basketball brilliance to lead the team to a title as a student strategist. His success earns him respect and inspires Bree to choose her own path.

programme.title: Ugly Girl Gets Revenge on 5 Pretty Girls
programme.desc: After Mallory's squad tests "ugly" Audrey, they reveal they were shielding her from Mallory's sabotage. The girls revolt against Mallory's toxicity, crowning Audrey the new queen of Bookside High.

programme.title: Mom Forces Daughter to Livestream Life
programme.desc: Beth forces her daughter Piper to livestream by faking a financial crisis. Piper exposes the lie to pursue her basketball dreams, prompting Beth to change her ways and support her daughter's future.

programme.title: Pop the Balloon Show Turned Into Her Worst Day
programme.desc: Jules enters a dating show looking for love but finds only clout-chasers. After a cruel betrayal by a contestant, she nearly gets crushed by an AC unit—only to be saved by her true soulmate, Ro.

programme.title: Stepmom Sabotages Girl's Dream
programme.desc: Meg, daughter of a late golf legend, must win a long-drive contest to inherit her father's fortune. Despite sabotage from her stepmom and elitist bullies, she triumphs and finds love with Trish.

programme.title: Billionaire and Pizza Boy Fall in Love
programme.desc: A sheltered rich girl falls for her pizza delivery boy, but her trusted nanny's scheme to steal a priceless heirloom nearly tears them apart before Ashley exposes the real thieves.

programme.title: Rich Girl and Poor Boy Not Allowed to Date
programme.desc: A broke, artistic teen navigates bullying and an abusive ex at a wealthy school, while his friendship with a reality star's daughter unexpectedly transforms both their lives.

programme.title: Mom Wants Daughter To Marry For Money
programme.desc: Trapped in a shallow engagement, Mona escapes by marrying Adrian, a kind waiter. Despite family disapproval and financial struggles, they pursue their dreams - her poetry, his culinary arts - finding true love and success by embracing their authentic selves.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bonuspunkte an der Kasse kann doch keiner mehr sehen – Koi-Karpfen sind dagegen der letzte Schrei! Das kann man von einer Darmspiegelung nicht gerade sagen, aber der gemeine Arschkriecher muss ja irgendwie wieder raus.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Kinderschminken kann aber auch einfach unheimlich echt wirken – Vorsicht ist angesagt! Sensible Küchengeräte wiederum sollte man nicht mit Horrorfilmen verschrecken. Diese und weitere Weisheiten gibt's bei Ladykracher.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: „Haben Sie mal einen Moment Zeit“? Diese Frage ist meist nur der Anfang vom Ende – erst recht bei Ladykracher! Da kann auch mal ein Badenazi genauer unter die Lupe genommen werden und ein Mann schwanger sein. Verrückt? Ja, das ist Ladykracher!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Egal ob als naive Ulla, magische Mutter oder männerfressende Onka – Anke weiß immer zu überzeugen. In dieser Episode ist sie unter anderem in einer Änderungs-Cafeteria unterwegs oder aber tritt ihrem Chef als Geist gegenüber.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: So manch Hundebesitzer schafft es nicht den Kot seines Hundes zu entsorgen. Anke hat da ihre ganz eigene Methode den Gehweg sauber zu halten. Aber hat sie da vielleicht etwas falsch verstanden?!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Beim Cash Call Gewinnspiel der lokalen Radiosender kann sich selbst die Polizei nicht zurück halten. Deswegen muss die Leitung möglichst schnell wieder frei für den nächsten wichtigen Gewinn-Anruf sein.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: In Zeiten der globalen Erwärmung sollte man sich auch beim Kopieren Gedanken um die Umwelt machen und möglichst wenig Papier verschwenden – Auch wenn es um Kopien der eigenen Geschlechtsteile geht.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Ob "Beziehungen", "Castingbits" oder "Nackt" - bei dem großen Ladykracher-Special gibt es das große A-Z zu Deutschlands beliebtester Sketchcomedy. Dabei gibt es ein Wiedersehen mit Onka, Ulla, Flo und co, sowei die lustigsten Highlights aus der aktuellen fünften Staffel. Das sollte man auf keinen Fall verpassen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Heike und ihr Sohn steuern ein Boot auf dem Wasser mit der Fernbedienung – oder ist es doch der Vater in der Familie, der da ferngesteuert wird? Außerdem gibt ab jetzt Kim Jong Il seine Meinung zu Gott und der Welt ab. Das klingt doch stark nach den langersehnten neuen Folgen von Ladykracher!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Frau Dr. Schlüter-Monheim hat einen Auftrag: Sie ist von der Märchenwald AG mit der Prozessoptimierung betraut worden. Das bedeutet: der Prinz kann auf keine Fall Dornröschen wachküssen, Hans-im-Glück muss dringend befördert werden, das tapfere Schneiderlein soll wegen Verstoßes gegen den Tierschutz abgemahnt werden. Und der Froschkönig kriegt vielleicht doch einfach einen Kuss?

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Pärchenabend in einer Designer-Wohnung. Die Gastgeber geben sich alle Mühe, einen gemütlichen Abend mit ihren Gästen zu zelebrieren. Einzig die Designer-Stühle stören ein wenig …! Neu in der Ladykracher-Familie in der sechsten Staffel: der koreanische Diktator Kim Jong Il – lakonisch portraitiert von Anke Engelke.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Maja und Rainer sind gemeinsam in der Bahn unterwegs als Majas Handy klingelt und der Anrufer von ihr Telefonsex verlangt. Rainer ist empört. Maja bleibt freundlich und versucht zu helfen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Richard Wildfeuer möchte 200 Euro bei seiner Bank abheben. Fräulein Klinger weist höflich auf die Turbulenzen an den internationalen Finanzmärkten hin, aber Herr Wildfeuer besteht auf die Auszahlung. Schließlich einigt man sich darauf, dass die Kollegin Frau Birkner zunächst einmal ein bisschen nett zu Herr Wildfeuer ist.
